notes.title: Update v1.070 (Physics + Balancing)
notes.notes:
This update adds a simple physics engine into the game.
When I first began designing this game I wanted to focus on performance and having an additional iteration of calculations was why it was never considered.
However, after implementing and testing the physics system, I think the sacrifice in performance was worth it.

The physics adds a new dynamic to the game which gives the player more control over situations.
Using the hero, the player can move monsters by walking into them, which can help with surviving in those time-crucial moments.
Having physics also helps alleviate the overlapping of monsters by causing them to spread out.


[b]Misc Changes[/b]
Fixed issues with associated with increasing speed of the game and intersections of high speed projectiles.
Fixed an issue with saving and resuming a map on normal difficulty that caused the towers to not work anymore.
Redesigned the level dialog layout.
Saved games now track and respawn any dragons that were from previous waves.

[b]Balancing[/b]
Stunning and Dazing the Dragon will now have diminishing results.
Flying monsters now have a bit more health.
Removed the radar "targets" upgrade. (Essentially was a double/duplicate for any valid towers in range)
Mini-gun towers now have less damage, slower rate of fire, and less range.
Missile towers now have less damage, less range, and slower rate of fire.
Chain lightning towers now have less damage, range, total chains and cost more.
Reduced damage of fork lightning towers.
Phase cannon towers now have less damage and slower rate of fire.
Reduced rate of fire of wave ray towers.
Flash bomb tower has slower rate of fire and the daze buff has been reduced to 2 seconds.
Nail tower has reduced rate of fire.
Saw blade towers have reduced damage and slower rate of fire.

notes.title: v1.061 Update
notes.notes:
Hard Difficulty can be accessed now without having to beat the last level.
Fixed the tutorial which was trying to upgrade into a tower no longer available.

notes.title: Update v1.060 (Game Balancing)
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Tower Balancing[/b][/h3]
It is now easier to get the different types of towers earlier in the game.
The price of all towers has been reduced significantly and all damage has been reduced accordingly.
You no longer have to upgrade base towers to level 3 to get the next types of towers for that base.
This means you will be upgrading, building, and expanding quickly as the level progresses.

[h3][b]Passives[/b][/h3]
A new Passive Tree has been added to the game which gives minor upgrades to towers, heroes, and misc things.
You earn 1 point for each level on normal mode and 3 points on hard.

[h3][b]Other Noteworthy Changes[/b][/h3]
Heroes can now take damage from monsters and will die if health reaches zero. They will have a minute downtime and be resurrected at the command center.
Only ground monsters that do not cast anything will attack the hero.

Lightning towers now "shock" monsters which increases damage taken for a very short duration of time. 
Replaced the Mega Lightning tower with a lightning nova tower which discharges electricity in a circle around the tower.

A lot of the debuffs that immobilize monsters have been reduced in either the chance or the value applied.

A new monster has been added to Hard difficulty which is immune to all debuffs.
Hard difficulty now has increased frequency of attacking monsters.

notes.title: Camera Changes

v1.054

[b]Noteworthy Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Camera can now zoom out past the natural bounds, allowing you to see the entire level.
[*] Camera movement should be more stable when panning in a single direction.
[*] Added shortcuts for camera zoom and movement for desktop users.
[*] Added a sensitivity scale for camera zoom in the settings.
[*] Added option to quit the game in the menu dropdown.
[*] Fixed the label for the hero scientist in the hero selection screen (no longer coming soon...)
[*] Clicking on a monster's name in the side panel will now show the description dialog for additional information.
[/list]


This update makes some changes to how the camera operates. The most notable change is the camera can zoom out allowing the player to see the entire level. There are also changes to how the camera will move when using the mouse so it is more stable. Hotkeys have also been added for the camera's zoom and movement.

notes.title: Minor Balancing/Changes

v1.053

[b]Noteworthy Changes[/b]

[list]

notes.title: Update v1.040 (Heroes)
notes.notes:
This update introduces heroes into the game who give an little extra help to each level when used. Currently, there are two different heroes, each a set of skills that are unlocked by gaining experience and leveling up.

[b]The soldier can use a concussion grenade to daze monsters temporarily.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38706390/333d1395d8826ddb45829e78adb81097dae09bdf.gif[/img]

[b]The engineer can buff towers temporally making them much more powerful.
[/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38706390/09c10bb4f157da94d57d8dd1ec9b00c30bf5a695.gif[/img]


Please note that the heroes are not final and things will change in the near future. The interface for hero selection is a prototype and will be overhauled soon but I wanted to get a testing version out so I can get feedback on the heroes!

notes.title: Update v1.0340 -- Shortcuts (aka Hotkeys)
notes.notes:
Added a new system for shortcuts to allow the player to do some of the basic functions in game by pressing a key instead. The current release maps all the main buttons, such as Pause/Resume, Speed control, Rushing and building new towers. The shortcuts can be remapped to different keys by opening the settings window and clicking the Shortcuts tab.

In addition to the shortcuts, I also added a minor feature for placing multiple towers by holding down shift while placing. This will allow you to move the tower around without dragging and will allow you to build by clicking the left mouse button and will setup a new placement of the same tower type so you can quickly plan/build many towers.

notes.title: Update v1.0330
notes.notes:
Replaced Monster Textures for Demon, Crow, Rat, and Dog... which look much better than the placeholder textures that were being used.

The Hound Master (Summoner) will now summon a dog every half second instead of all at once.

And a few bug fixes...

notes.title: Update v1.0320
notes.notes:
[b]Changes[/b]
More editor improvements.. can now select groups from side panel, change color of light objects.
Added some more editor checks to verify map will actually be playable.
Removed all the unused Towers and Effects from default properties.
Replaced all the poison tower turret textures with something better.
Added new path tile set for first set of levels.
Fixed the dragon's fire ability not rendering.
Loading Screen has been redone to be more simple looking.


Patch 1.030 introduced the editor as a main feature and this last month has been dedicated to getting certain quality of life features implemented into the editor. I still have plans to add some more features into the editor while improving on some of the current features. I may also return to the editor to redo the interface but this isn't a high priority at the moment.

I did manage to make a few videos on how to use the editor which can be found on the [url=https://deadtd.com/forum/]forums[/url]. I plan on making at least a few more videos explaining the wave and spawns and other properties not yet covered.

As for the future, I am going to switch my focus to creating and refining the core content of the game. So over the next few months I plan on redoing a lot of the core assets, rebalancing of monsters and towers. I also plan on adding some music and adding the sounds for the towers that have been added over the last few months.

notes.title: Update v1.0310 (Editor Access)
notes.notes:
This update enables access to the editor and some other features previously unavailable! These features are still in development but are stable enough for testing and feedback.

[h3]Editor[/h3]
The editor is a tool that can be used to create custom levels. This has been in development for a little while now and contains many features to allow for customization. Tutorials on how to use some of these advanced features will be coming soon. You can find the videos on the [url=https://deadtd.com/forum/]official forums[/url] if you are interested. Desktop users will have access to the "Towers" map which is a level that has all the towers and can be opened in the editor so you can test stuff out yourself.

[h3]Custom Map Sharing[/h3]
Another feature is the custom map sharing which has been implemented over the last month and is considered very experimental. You can access the public maps by going to the level selection screen, clicking the Menu Button and then the Custom button. This will connect to the server, getting any custom maps posted and allowing you to play it. Custom maps created in the editor can also be posted to this public server by using the Upload button in the editor menu. Please note this requires internet access. Also the interface is very limited at this moment so things like searching, filtering and sorting are not implemented yet. 

[b]Some other things..[/b]
Bombardment Towers have been redone!
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/S1Gm3GsY0gr4By1wV2/giphy.gif[/img]

The summoner ("hound master") now has a new texture which replaces the low quality one it was using.
Some minor bug fixes and maybe even some new bugs :)

Finally, feedback is always appreciated! 
You can post on the steam discussion board with any comments/questions/feedback. 
Or you can visit the website forums [url=https://www.deadtd.com/forum/]The official forums[/url]

notes.title: Update v1.011
notes.notes:
Hello Fellow Gamers!

An update to Dead TD has been posted which enables access to all the levels without having to unlock them.

Below is a quick summary of the new update..

[list]
[*] The overall audio data has been adjusted, normalizing the loudness. (It's not so loud anymore!)
[*] Minor fixes and changes to the tower textures and effects. All the Frost Tower textures have been updated.
[*] Did some minor adjustments to the levels, it will rotate between mazable and single pathing levels.
[*] Currently all levels are unlocked and available to play...
[*] And a difficulty option of "Hard" has been added. This option will set the level to 100 waves, increase the difficulty by 25%, enables all monsters to spawn, and has no restrictions on what can spawn and when.
[/list]

notes.title: Audio Update!
notes.notes:
With my first initial release on steam, most of the feedback was about sound and why there was none! Adding sounds was always on the list of things to do but I needed to figure out how best to implement it. My original thought was it would be nearly impossible to distinguish between the sounds once the level had a lot of towers and effects in play.  After some thought, I was able to implement a system where sound effects are played based upon the camera, which also led to performance improvements!

Currently, most towers have a sound effect which is played when selecting it or after construction is complete. Also, most monsters have a sound effect which is played also when selecting it or when special type of waves occur. Finally, a lot of towers have a sound effect that is played when it fires a projectile. As time goes on, I will add and improve the sounds played.

Also, I was able to add new tower textures for many of the old towers, at least 15 of the towers have been updated visually. This leaves only a few towers that still need to be updated which I hope to have done soon, within the next month.

Finally, Any and All Feedback is very much appreciated! Feel free to post in the discussion board on steam with any questions, comments, etc.


Until next time...
